claims.claim: Frontend mockIPC cannot certify Rust command execution.
Capability denial must be tested at runtime authority, where denied commands are not invoked.
Desktop host tests can dispatch real InvokeRequest values through a registered plugin under MockRuntime.
Mobile certification must cross PluginHandle into annotated Kotlin or Swift code.
Specta rc.24/rc.25 cannot satisfy the repository's Rust 1.88 minimum because it uses standard-library APIs stabilized later.
Stable release remains blocked without mobile runtime artifacts.
